title: Slow English Podcast #365: 20 Easy Facts About Bhutan

sentences.text: Today we will learn about a beautiful country in South Asia.
I will speak slowly and use easy English.
Bhutan is a small country in South Asia.
It is between India and China.
The country is in the Himalaya Mountains.
Bhutan is famous for its nature, mountains and peaceful life.
Many people visit Bhutan every year.
Thimphu is the capital of Bhutan.
It is the largest city in the country.
Many people live and work there.
The city has temples, markets and beautiful views.
Thimphu is a peaceful capital city.
The Himalaya Mountains cover much of Bhutan.
People enjoy hiking and exploring nature.
The mountains are important for the country's culture.
Dzongka is the national language of Bhutan.
Many other local languages are also spoken.
English is also used in education.
Bhutan has a rich language culture.
Bhutan is known for gross national happiness.
Bhutan measures happiness as an important part of life.
The country believes that people's well -being is important.
Nature, culture and community are valued.
Many people know Bhutan for this special idea.
Happiness is part of Bhutanese culture.
Buddhism is the main religion of Bhutan.
People visit these places for prayer and peace.
Buddhist traditions are part of daily life.
The forests protect plants and animals.
Bhutan is one of the countries with rich natural beauty.
These clothes are worn during special events.
Temples and monasteries are very special.
Many special animals live in Bhutan.
The taiki is the national animal.
Snow leopards and red pandas also live there.
Spring brings flowers and green forests.
Winter is cold in the mountains.
Each season has its own beauty.
They grow rice, vegetables, and fruits.
They watch dances and music performances.
Festivals are full of color and joy.
Archery is very popular in Bhutan.
Teams compete in villages and cities.
The country cares about the environment.
Many forests and animals are protected.
People try to live in harmony with nature.
Clean air and beautiful landscapes are important.
Visitors often say Bhutanese people are kind and welcoming.
Bhutan welcomes visitors from around the world.
The country protects its culture and nature.
People visit temples, mountains and villages.
Chili and cheese are used in many dishes.
Ima Dachi is a famous Bhutanese meal.
Food is part of the culture.
Bhutan is a country full of nature, culture and happiness.
It has beautiful mountains, peaceful monasteries, green forests, unique traditions and friendly people.
Visitors can enjoy nature, history and local culture.
Bhutan may be small, but it offers unforgettable experiences.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I hope you learned something new today.
Keep listening, keep practicing and keep enjoying English.
See you in the next episode.
